releaseNotes:
## Reports
- Year-to-date figures stay calculated, and you can type over them on the monthly report
- Income and expenditure YTD starts as last month plus this month. A typed YTD is what later months add onto. Auto restores the calculation
- Statistics YTD starts from bookings. A typed YTD is the base for later months in the same year
- Room occupancy keeps a typed YTD until a later month changes it
